title: Composite base-change prefix before applying the open counit
statement: Let gprime:Xprime→X, fprime:Xprime→Sprime, f:X→S and g:Sprime→S form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Choose the derived categories, pullbacks, adjunctions, and comparison mates of [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. Let K be in D(X), and let W and U be arbitrary opens of X. Put C=R(U→X)L(U→X)K and A=R(U→S)L(U→X)K. Take the fprime-transpose of the canonical local U base-change arrow followed by the inverse Uprime,fprime direct-image comparison. Pull it back along Wprime→Xprime and precompose with the inverse Wprime,fprime pullback comparison. This equals the W composite-square comparison at A, followed by pullback along Wprime→W of the inverse W,f pullback comparison and LW of the f counit precomposed with Lf of the inverse U,f direct-image comparison, then the W coefficient comparison at C, and finally L(Wprime→Xprime) of the single U-open base-change arrow followed by the U coefficient comparison. No inclusion W⊆U is required. No target open counit is applied on either side.

proof.text: Expand the canonical local U arrow. The inverse right-adjoint uniqueness comparison identifies its fprime transpose with the Uprime transpose of the full composite base-change adjunct, preceded by the forward Uprime,fprime pullback comparison. Expand base change by the pinned counit description. The mate counit identity expresses the U,f composite counit as inverse pullback comparison, pullback of the f counit precomposed with the inverse U,f image comparison, and the U counit. Apply coefficient-square pasting at U, cancel the comparison and its inverse, and use adjunction naturality to retranspose. This proves the unpulled local transpose formula with the single U base-change arrow and coefficient comparison.

Specialize coefficient_square_pasting to the square for f and the open W, with identity coefficient morphism. Precompose and postcompose with the comparison isomorphisms to obtain the equality between the rectangle comparison and the pullback of the f-square comparison. Naturality of the W coefficient comparison extends this equality to any map Lf(A) to C. Apply it to Lf of the inverse U,f image comparison followed by the f counit, then postcompose with pullback of the single U base-change arrow and coefficient comparison. Functor.map_comp and associativity combine this with the unpulled transpose formula to give exactly the unchanged statement. No W-to-U inclusion or target open counit is used.

theorem relativeMV_composite_baseChange_prefix
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (W U : X.Opens) :
    let C := (schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)
    let A := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (U.ι ≫ f)).obj ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)
    let θ := (relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' U.ι) U.ι).hom.app K ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
        (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := U.ι)).symm) ≫
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' U.ι) g').inv.app K
    (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' W.ι) f').inv.app
      (relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K ((derivedPullback g').obj K) (𝟙 _) U).left ≫
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' W.ι)).map
        (((relativeMVAdj f').homEquiv _ _).symm
          ((relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K ((derivedPullback g').obj K)
              (𝟙 _) U).hom ≫
            (relativeMVImageComp (pullback.fst g' U.ι) f').inv.app
              ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).obj
                ((derivedPullback g').obj K)))) =
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' W.ι ≫ f') g).hom.app A ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj A)
        (show pullback.snd g' W.ι ≫ (W.ι ≫ f) =
            (pullback.fst g' W.ι ≫ f') ≫ g by
          rw [← pullback.condition_assoc, Category.assoc, hpull.w, ← Category.assoc]).symm) ≫
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' W.ι) (W.ι ≫ f)).inv.app A ≫
      (derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' W.ι)).map
        ((relativeMVComp W.ι f).inv.app A ≫
          (derivedPullback W.ι).map
            ((derivedPullback f).map ((relativeMVImageComp U.ι f).inv.app
                ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)) ≫ (relativeMVAdj f).counit.app C)) ≫
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' W.ι) W.ι).hom.app C ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj C)
        (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := W.ι)).symm) ≫
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' W.ι) g').inv.app C ≫
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' W.ι)).map
        (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap U.ι (pullback.fst g' U.ι) g'
            (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := U.ι)).symm
            ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K) ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).map θ)
